title: Business Central Administration Center API MCP Server (preview)

facts.text: Business Central Admin Center API MCP server is in public preview.
MCP server located at https://mcp.businesscentral.dynamics.com/admin/v1 exposes admin APIs in standardized way.
AI agents can discover available admin operations and propose follow-up actions while keeping users in control.
Connect to MCP server in Visual Studio Code, Copilot Studio, or other tools supporting MCP.
Six endpoints are excluded during preview: Set security group, Clear security group, Delete environment, Rename environment, Link Power Platform environment, Unlink Power Platform environment.
Sample MCP Proxy on GitHub demonstrates multi-tenant administration but is not supported for production use.
